content:
Maya: FYI  our new Manager of Infra ML starts Mon 9am PT. Need: a one-page candidate agenda, a manager 30/60/90 checklist, and a short day-by-day week0 plan. Anita can you take point?
Anita: on it. quick clarifying Qs: buddy confirmed?, laptop imaging Friday?, NDA for datasets?
Maya: Buddy = Carlos mornings. IT can image if asset tag sent by EOD today. Legal flagged a partial NDA for dataset access  Renee, can you confirm?
Renee: yes, NDA required for dataset access. Ill prepare the link and note it as a gating item in the candidate email.
Carlos: Ill hold 09:30-10:00 daily pairing for first 2 weeks. Will add "how to run local tests" doc to calendar invite.
it-bot: Action created: /it ticket #4521 request laptop image + Okta + GitHub org invite (owner: IT).
Anita: Draft week0 (very lean):
Mon AM: welcome, laptop + Okta handoff, Slack intro, add to Redwood Console dev org
Mon PM: 30m team demo + repo access pairing
Tue: codebase tour + first micro-task (setup + test run)
Wed: infra runbook & Grafana walkthrough + security primer (NDA check)
Thu: deploy path + smoke canary run with buddy
Fri: 30m manager sync + buddy retro + plan for week2
Anita: Candidate one-pager blurb (short):
- 30d: env ready, 12 small PRs merged, comfortable running tests
- 60d: owns a non-peak deploy window, responds using incident playbook
- 90d: independent deploys + presents a short tech writeup on a perf improvement idea
Anita: Manager 30/60/90 checklist (concise):
- Week0: confirm accounts, daily 15m check-ins, assign 3 micro-tasks
- 30d: two merged PRs, buddy feedback, runbook read & basic tests passed
- 60d: owns deploy for one service (canary), incident debug demonstration
- 90d: leads a service review, proposes OKR-linked improvement, independent deploys
Maya: Add "manager quick tips" in packet: explicit acceptance criteria for micro-tasks, schedule weekly 1:1, give mid-30d formative feedback.
Anita: I'll post both the candidate one-pager and the manager checklist here as plain text later today. Also adding a 1-line candidate email snippet: "Welcome! Please complete NDA (link) to unlock dataset access. Your buddy will reach out to book morning pairing. See attached 30/60/90 one-pager."
Renee: NDA link ready; will DM Anita the URL.
Carlos: I'll confirm calendar invites and add pairing doc.
Maya: Great — once Anita posts, I'll sign off and Hiring Manager will send. Thanks team :raised_hands:
